name: Exla
long_description:
Exla is your 24/7 AI SRE agent. It reads your production logs, traces, and deploys, and holds full context on your codebase. It establishes a live baseline of normal behavior, so when something silently regresses, it catches the deviation immediately, pins it to the exact commit that caused it, and opens a fix PR. No paging a human at 3am, no digging through dashboards to find what changed.

https://cal.com/exla-ai/schedule
one_liner: Building agents that reads logs and fixes issues on your behalf.
